description: Na₂NHSO₃ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pccn space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to one N and five O atoms. The Na-N bond length is 2.51 Å. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.70 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to one N and five O atoms. The Na-N bond length is 2.49 Å. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.60 Å. N is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to two Na, one H, and one S atom. The N-H bond length is 1.03 Å. The N-S bond length is 1.58 Å. H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one N atom. S is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to one N and three O atoms. There is one shorter (1.49 Å) and two longer (1.51 Å) S-O bond lengths. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one S atom. In the second O site, O is bonded to three equivalent Na and one S atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₃S trigonal pyramids. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one S atom.
